notes.title: [Gladiator Update] Now Available! [Free Update]
notes.notes:
[b][Free Update Volume 1!][/b]
[b]The [Gladiator Update] has been released, adding new scenarios and new characters! [/b]
Three new playable characters and a new gladiator-themed scenario have been added!
Enjoy the deadly battles against approaching enemies in the arena with no escape!

notes.title: The new situation and new character addition update [Gladiator Update] /ver1.2.5
notes.notes:
The [b]new situation[/b] and [b]new character[/b] addition update [b][Gladiator Update] [/b]has been released!
*New scenarios themed around gladiators and three new playable characters have been added! Enjoy the deadly battles against approaching enemies in an inescapable arena!

*The hit detection for the special attack of the basic character [Soldier] in the Zombie stage has been changed to a crouching hit detection, allowing for counterattacks while avoiding high attacks.

*Several minor bugs have been fixed.

*Ver1.2.5

[b]新シチュエーション[/b]＆[b]新キャラクター[/b]追加アップデート[b][グラディエーター アップデート][/b]配信開始しました！
*剣闘士をテーマにした新しいシチュエーションと、新たなプレイアブルキャラクターを3体追加！逃げ場のない闘技場で迫りくる敵との死闘をお楽しみください！

*ゾンビステージ基本キャラクター[ソルジャー]のスペシャルアタック時の当たり判定をしゃがみ判定へと変更。高い位置の攻撃を避けつつ反撃できるようになりました。

*細かな不具合をいくつか修正しました。

*Ver1.2.5となります
